After training, quantization reduces its memory requirements, while retrieval-augmented generation lets it use external documents when answering questions.

source_context.text: A small transformer uses self-attention to process text and backpropagation to improve its predictions during training. Regularization helps it generalize beyond its training examples. After training, quantization reduces its memory requirements, while retrieval-augmented generation lets it use external documents when answering questions.

explanation_facts.intended_fact: A retrieval-augmented generation process involves a retriever component that searches an external document store for information relevant to a query.
The retriever component selects specific documents from the external store to form a context set for the current query.
The selected documents in the context set are injected into the transformer's input sequence alongside the original query text.
The transformer processes the augmented input sequence using self-attention to generate a response that synthesizes information from both the query and the retrieved documents.
